info.title: Tesearis.DotNetAssemblyQuery.Cli
info.description: A tiny, fast CLI that answers "where is this symbol / what calls it" by reading compiled .NET assemblies and their PDBs - no build, no workspace, no decompiler.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Assembly (.dll) to include (repeatable).

options.name: --dir
options.description: Directory to scan for .dll files (repeatable).

options.name: --source-root
options.description: Root directory used to resolve/display source locations. [default: <path>]

options.name: --no-daemon
options.description: Run in-process only; never try or spawn a background daemon. [default: False]

options.name: --daemon-idle-timeout
options.description: Idle timeout in seconds before an auto-spawned daemon exits.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Restrict matches to this member kind: type, method, field, or property.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Restrict matches to this containing namespace.

options.name: --assembly-name
options.description: Restrict matches to this containing assembly name.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output machine-readable JSON instead of human-readable text. [default: False]
